description: This file defines the AuthEngine class, which handles authentication and key negotiation for Spark's network security, using X25519 Diffie-Hellman key exchange and AES-GCM encryption.

classes.name: AuthEngine
classes.description: Handles authentication, key exchange, and session cipher management for Spark network security.

methods.name: encryptEphemeralPublicKey
methods.description: Derives an AES-GCM key from a pre-shared secret and encrypts an ephemeral X25519 public key.

methods.name: decryptEphemeralPublicKey
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted ephemeral X25519 public key using a derived key.

methods.name: challenge
methods.description: Generates a challenge message with an ephemeral public key.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Processes a client challenge, computes shared secret, and prepares server response.

methods.name: deriveSessionCipher
methods.description: Derives and initializes the session cipher based on exchanged ephemeral keys.

methods.name: generateTransportCipher
methods.description: Creates a TransportCipher (AES-GCM or CTR) based on shared secret and configuration.

methods.name: getTranscript
methods.description: Concatenates and encodes multiple AuthMessages into a transcript byte array.

methods.name: sessionCipher
methods.description: Returns the current session cipher object.
